sprint: Planned Example Completion Gap Analysis and Full-Coverage Generation Design
phase: Phase 5 — Words Excluded Scenarios Root-Cause Deep Dive

excluded_runnable_scenarios.api_signature: Comparer.Compare(string inputFile1, string inputFile2, string outputFile, string author, DateTime dateTime)
excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: The planner builds a scenario with one input file. Comparer needs TWO different documents to compare. The template_hints in words.yml has merger_input_creation_lines (2 identical files) but comparing identical files produces no output differences — useless as an example. Need 2 structurally different DOCX files.
proposed_fix: Add comparer_input_creation_lines to words.yml with 2 documents that have a known difference
Extend planner._build_scenario to detect Compare() signature and inject paired inputs
Add DOCX output validation: diff output should contain revision marks

excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: Merger.Merge takes a string[] of input files. The planner only generates single-input scenarios. merger_input_creation_lines exist in words.yml but the planner does not use them for Merger scenarios. The LLM might handle this if the prompt includes the array signature, but fixture creation must produce 2+ valid DOCX files.
proposed_fix: Extend planner to detect array-input methods and include merger_input_creation_lines
Pass input_files count to prompt packet builder
Output validation: merged DOCX page count >= sum of input page counts

excluded_runnable_scenarios.api_signature: MailMerger.Execute(string inputFile, string outputFile, string[] fieldNames, object[] fieldValues)
excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: MailMerger needs a DOCX template with merge field placeholders (e.g., <<FirstName>>). The pipeline must know the field names to pass as fieldNames[]. No template-with-merge-fields fixture strategy exists. The LLM could create a template programmatically using Aspose.Words DocumentBuilder.InsertField('MERGEFIELD FirstName'), but this requires knowledge of the merge field API.
proposed_fix: Add mail_merge_template_creation_lines to words.yml with known field names
Include field names in scenario metadata so prompt can reference them
Add validation: output DOCX should contain the field values, not the field placeholders

excluded_runnable_scenarios.api_signature: ReportBuilder.BuildReport(string inputFile, string outputFile, object data, string dataSourceName)
excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: ReportBuilder uses LINQ Reporting Engine syntax (<<[field]>>) in templates. Needs a DOCX template with LINQ tags AND matching data object. More complex than MailMerger. The data parameter requires specific types.
proposed_fix: Include LINQ tag names and data structure in scenario metadata
May require custom data class generation in Program.cs

excluded_runnable_scenarios.detail: Processor uses a builder/fluent API pattern: new Processor().From(input).To(output).Execute(). The planner and prompt system assume static-method or instance-method-with-options patterns. Builder pattern is not modeled. However, the LLM might handle this if the prompt clearly describes the fluent API.
proposed_fix: Add Processor few-shot to words.yml template_hints or to packet_builder
The simple From/To/Execute pattern may 'just work' with good prompt guidance
excluded_runnable_scenarios.estimated_effort: low — may work with prompt change alone

additional_blocked_advanced_scenario.note: Splitter is already in the allowlist and ExtractPages works. Splitter.Split(SplitOptions) is the ADVANCED scenario blocked by missing SplitCriteria enum values.
additional_blocked_advanced_scenario.detail: SplitCriteria is an enum in Aspose.Words.LowCode. DllReflector does not output enum member names/values. Without knowing SplitCriteria.PageBreak, SplitCriteria.SectionBreak, etc., the planner cannot build a valid scenario.
additional_blocked_advanced_scenario.proposed_fix: Add enum value enumeration to DllReflector. Then add SplitCriteria.SectionBreak to Split scenario.

docx_semantic_validation.current_state: Output validation checks file existence and size. No text extraction from DOCX XML. Replacer output was manually verified (World present, {{name}} absent) but not automated.
docx_semantic_validation.gap: No automated DOCX text extraction validator
docx_semantic_validation.impact: Low — all 4 published Words examples work. Becomes important when MailMerger and ReportBuilder produce output that must be semantically validated.
docx_semantic_validation.proposed_fix: Add DOCX XML text extraction to output_validator.py. Use zipfile + xml.etree to read word/document.xml.
